name: sel-reinforcement
description: Property keywords for the 3DEC 7.0 legacy SEL local reinforcement element ('sel reinforcement create by-line ... / sel reinforcement property <i> <keyword> <value>'). 7.0-only: absent from 9.x. Scripting access: itasca.sel.reinforcement.

property_groups.description: Live-enumerated on 3DEC 7.00 Release 161 with an element present. Semantics are static-grade (7.0 HTML page).
